name: Andrii Deisan
intro: I build web products with React, Next.js, and TypeScript — from personalized journeys and checkout to tools that help teams work faster.
summary: I’m a Product Engineer with a strong frontend focus and 4+ years of experience building web products. My work spans experimentation, personalization, e-commerce, and internal tooling. I collaborate with product, design, backend, and ML teams, combining product context with attention to performance, testing, and maintainability.

impact.title: Paywall-to-purchase conversion
impact.text: Team-reported relative increase for Scratch Promocode, where I implemented product updates.

bullets: Developed marketing funnels, personalized components, conditional flows, and AI Tutor frontend features with product, design, backend, and ML colleagues.

Implemented updates to Profile Summary and Scratch Promocode. Team-reported relative A/B results: +15% ARPU for Profile Summary; +40% ARPU, +60% paywall-to-purchase conversion, and −40% cancellation rate for Scratch Promocode.
Improved Solidgate checkout and Apple Pay web behavior, optimized asset/data loading, and fixed device-data handling. Added unit tests and Grafana monitoring.

Built Strapi/GrowthBook experimentation tools, CMS preview, and funnel visualization. Simplified the workflow from 6 steps to 1 click; team-reported testing cadence grew from 7–10 to 30–35 tests/month. Automated localized sales-page duplication: 8 hours to 5 minutes (PM estimate).

Improved Amplitude and Meta Pixel/CAPI delivery through frontend and targeted existing Go/Fiber changes. Team-reported Purchase Event Match Quality rose from 7.7 to 8.3/10. Wrote a Strapi cleanup migration and verified recovery with DevOps.
Developed frontend-to-CMS MCP workflows and quiz-design, creative-generation, and ad-research tools. Used Claude Code and BMAD Method for AI-assisted development.
Built drag-and-drop page composition and public rendering so managers could assemble blog and product pages independently.
Developed e-commerce catalog, search, cart, delivery, and admin features; integrated backend APIs and blog CRUD with media and SEO fields.
Reduced client JavaScript through bundle analysis and library removal; migrated Webpack to Rspack for faster builds and development updates.
Created and maintained Zod schemas for checkout, cart, and localized blogs, linking runtime validation with TypeScript types and error handling.
Maintained React SSR, localization, and typed Redux/reselect selectors; added targeted Jest date-validation tests. Collaborated with backend, design, and QA.
Developed React/TypeScript features, integrated REST/GraphQL APIs, and used Redux Toolkit and Effector for state management.
Applied Feature-Sliced Design and collaborated with product and design teams in an agile environment.
Updated content and HTML/CSS; configured SEO and optimized website pages for search engines.
